title: Qi Fu Yin ameliorates neuroinflammation through inhibiting RAGE and TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway in AD model rats.
authors: He, Chunxiang; Yu, Wenjing; Yang, Miao; Li, Ze; Yu, Jingping; Zhong, Dayuan; Deng, Sisi; Song, Zhenyan; Cheng, Shaowu
one_liner_zh: 该研究用网络药理学和分子对接分析中药启福饮治疗阿尔茨海默病的抗炎靶点，但核心是药物-蛋白相互作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the therapeutic effect of Qi Fu Yin (QFY) on Alzheimer's disease (AD) both computationally and experimentally. Network pharmacology analysis and molecular docking were conducted to identify potential targets and signaling pathways involved in QFY treating AD. Streptozotocin-induced AD rat model was used to verify important targets and predicted pathways. The components of QFY were identified using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. The results indicate that the potential targets of QFY are highly enriched for anti-inflammatory pathways. Molecular docking analysis revealed stable structures formed between QFY's active compounds, including stigmasterol, beta-sitosterol, and isorhamnetin, and the identified targets. In vivo, QFY improved cognitive memory in AD rats and reduced the mRNA expression levels of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), the receptor for advanced glycation end products (AGER), and the inflammatory factors interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) in the brains of AD rats. Furthermore, QFY effectively reduced nuclear translocation of nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) and inhibited NF-kappaB and microglia activation. In conclusion, QFY can ameliorate neuroinflammation in AD model rats, partly via the inhibition of TLR4 and RAGE/NF-kappaB pathway and microglia activation, thereby enhancing learning and memory in AD model rats.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过计算和实验两种手段探讨启复饮（QFY）对阿尔茨海默病（AD）的治疗效果。采用网络药理学分析和分子对接技术，识别QFY治疗AD的潜在靶点及信号通路。利用链脲佐菌素诱导的AD大鼠模型，验证重要靶点和预测通路。通过液相色谱-串联质谱法鉴定QFY的组分。结果表明，QFY的潜在靶点高度富集于抗炎通路。分子对接分析显示，QFY的活性化合物（包括豆甾醇、β-谷甾醇和异鼠李素）与所识别靶点之间形成了稳定结构。在体内实验中，QFY改善了AD大鼠的认知记忆能力，并降低了AD大鼠脑内toll样受体4（TLR4）、晚期糖基化终末产物受体（AGER）及炎症因子白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）的mRNA表达水平。此外，QFY有效减少了核因子-κB（NF-κB）的核转位，并抑制了NF-κB及小胶质细胞的激活。总之，QFY可通过部分抑制TLR4和RAGE/NF-κB通路及小胶质细胞激活，改善AD模型大鼠的神经炎症，从而增强其学习记忆能力。
